purpose: VM de referência principal deste projeto para Domain/OS SR10.4 com HP VUE 2.01 em Apollo DN3500 no MAME
disk_policy: runtime disk and private disk name are hard links to the same live inode; ignored by Git; never copy or replace while MAME is running

base_backup.warning: pristine base only; not a replacement for the current assistant clone

mame.mouse_capture: AltGr releases capture temporarily; user reports capture returns when MAME window is reactivated with pointer outside
mame.screen_wake: physical mouse movement or physical keyboard input

network.isolation: MAME-specific network namespace; created by launch script
network.ftp_mode: active; client return/source address 192.168.240.1 via helper

owner_scope: This VM is exclusive to irixium-kde-custom and must not be shared with other projects or substituted with another clone.
